scope: Primary literature and official specifications supporting evidence-packing hypotheses; these sources are not execution receipts or results from this study.

sources.title: RECOMP: Improving Retrieval-Augmented LMs with Compression and Selective Augmentation
sources.authors: Fangyuan Xu, Weijia Shi, Eunsol Choi
sources.access: Full HTML inspected, especially methods and faithfulness qualification.
sources.mechanism: Trained extractive and abstractive retrieval compressors; selective augmentation.
sources.transfer_limit: Untrained source-exact lexical windows do not reproduce RECOMP or inherit its outcomes. Extraction can omit necessary context.

sources.title: Late Chunking: Contextual Chunk Embeddings Using Long-Context Embedding Models
sources.authors: Michael Günther, Isabelle Mohr, Daniel James Williams, Bo Wang, Han Xiao
sources.access: Full HTML inspected, including method, retrieval experiments and synthetic-task limitations.
sources.mechanism: Embed document tokens before pooling short chunks, preserving contextual representations.
sources.transfer_limit: Our packer does not implement late chunking or a contextual encoder; irrelevant surrounding text may add no value.

sources.title: LongRAG: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Long-context LLMs
sources.authors: Ziyan Jiang, Xueguang Ma, Wenhu Chen
sources.access: Full HTML inspected, including related-document grouping and granularity ablations.
sources.mechanism: Long related-document retrieval units preserve context and support multi-document reading.
sources.transfer_limit: Its corpus/readers differ from fictional task memory; motivates a whole-unit counter-hypothesis rather than a guaranteed benefit.

sources.title: Summarization: (1) Using MMR for Diversity-Based Reranking and (2) Evaluating Summaries
sources.access: ACL paper metadata and publisher-indexed abstract inspected.
sources.mechanism: Balance relevance with novelty to reduce redundancy in document/passage selection.
sources.transfer_limit: The prototype's query-token and Jaccard heuristic is not an implementation of the original scoring model.

sources.title: Multi-document Summarization via Budgeted Maximization of Submodular Functions
sources.access: Publisher-indexed abstract/method excerpt and ACL paper identity inspected; no comprehensive full-paper review.
sources.mechanism: Coverage-based extractive summarization under an explicit cost budget.
sources.transfer_limit: Query-word coverage and our greedy grouped heuristic do not establish complete task evidence or inherit approximation guarantees.

sources.title: A Class of Submodular Functions for Document Summarization
sources.access: ACL identity and publisher-indexed summarization description inspected; no comprehensive full-paper review.
sources.mechanism: Explicit coverage/diversity objectives for extractive selection.
sources.transfer_limit: Task evidence can have complementary jointly necessary facts, unlike a simple diminishing-return proxy.

sources.title: From RAG to Memory: Non-Parametric Continual Learning for Large Language Models
sources.authors: Bernal Jiménez Gutiérrez, Yiheng Shu, Weijian Qi, Sizhe Zhou, Yu Su
sources.mechanism: HippoRAG 2 associates passages with a knowledge graph and Personalized PageRank plus online LLM selection.
sources.transfer_limit: Declared-edge BFS is a control, not a reproduction of its semantic graph or biological mechanism.

sources.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
sources.access: Author abstract inspected; official GraphRAG retrieval documentation checked separately.
sources.mechanism: Entity graphs and community summaries support global corpus questions.
sources.transfer_limit: Global synthesis and narrow authority/correction retrieval need different tests; summary extraction introduces its own error surface.

sources.title: Referral Augmentation for Zero-Shot Information Retrieval
sources.authors: Michael Tang, Shunyu Yao, John Yang, Karthik Narasimhan
sources.mechanism: Incoming referring-document text augments the target document's search representation.
sources.transfer_limit: Referrals supply search cues, not target endorsement or independent evidence of a referred claim.

sources.title: Sufficient Context: A New Lens on Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
sources.authors: Hailey Joren, Jianyi Zhang, Chun-Sung Ferng, Da-Cheng Juan, Ankur Taly, Cyrus Rashtchian
sources.mechanism: Separates context insufficiency from failure to use sufficient context and studies abstention.
sources.transfer_limit: A sufficiency judge can err; source support, packet coverage and artifact completion require separate measurements.

sources.title: Evaluating the Search Agent in a Parallel World
sources.access: Author abstract inspected; full experimental tables were not independently audited.
sources.mechanism: Unfamiliar-world search benchmarks distinguish evidence collection, sufficiency judgment and stopping.
sources.transfer_limit: Web-search agents are adjacent to local filesystem memory; no quantitative result is transferred.

sources.title: Event Sourcing Pattern
sources.mechanism: Immutable source events, compensating changes and query-oriented materialized views.
sources.transfer_limit: Projection lag, schema evolution and infrastructure complexity remain costs; a small file vault does not necessarily need an event platform.

sources.title: PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model
sources.access: Official HTML inspected, including derivation, revision and quotation definitions.
sources.mechanism: Record provenance relationships between originals, quotations, revisions and derived entities.
sources.transfer_limit: Consistent provenance records help auditability but do not establish true content or semantic authority.

sources.title: Time in XTDB
sources.access: Official HTML inspected, distinguishing valid time and system time.
sources.mechanism: Track when facts apply separately from when the system learns them.
sources.transfer_limit: The prototype uses literal time-scope declarations, not full bitemporal SQL or interval reasoning.

sources.title: Movie-watching evokes ripple-like activity within events and at event boundaries
sources.access: PMC full text inspected after the publisher website's cookie redirect blocked direct retrieval.
sources.mechanism: Observational intracranial measurements in ten epilepsy patients link regional ripple patterns with event boundaries and later memory.
sources.transfer_limit: Clinical sample and recording constraints; motivates a segmentation hypothesis, not a filesystem or consolidation prescription.

sources.title: Encoding Processes in Recognition and Recall
sources.access: Publisher-indexed abstract inspected. Direct publisher-page retrieval failed; full article was not read.
sources.mechanism: Anticipated recall versus recognition tests favor different encoding relationships.
sources.transfer_limit: Engineering analogy only: local discrimination and cross-item relationships may suit different workloads; no biological effect size transfer.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.mechanism: Context position can affect information use in the studied retrieval/QA settings.
sources.transfer_limit: Current readers require new measurements; fixed-packet permutations isolate utilization from evidence retrieval.

unimplemented_hypotheses: Long-context late chunking with frozen token-to-source offsets
Source-linked abstractive summaries with compulsory original fallback
Inbound-referral text as search-only index cues
Valid/system-time interval queries independent of import order
Adaptive passage expansion after source-support verification
Fixed-packet order permutations with identical text and byte cost
Event/topic segmentation versus session-wide capture with equal retained content
Separate global-synthesis and narrow correction workloads
